record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Song<WH07892> of degrees<WH04609>.<Fo><Fo> In my distress<WH06869> I cried<WH07121><WTH8804> unto the LORD<WH03068>, and he heard<WH06030><WTH8799> me.

I <FI>am for<Fi> peace<WH07965>: but when I speak<WH01696><WTH8762>, they <FI>are<Fi> for war<WH04421>. <RF>for peace: or, a man of peace<Rf><CM>
